name: convergence_outcome
description: Convergence spike GO/NO-GO verdict (roadmap Phase 1, pre-registered bar): GO iff every item integrated onto one shared branch (zero big-bang merge), nothing was reopened, nothing was left undispatched by a budget halt, and the branch is green. Counts are read from the durable blackboard (reopen facts) plus the final pending set, so the verdict is an audit, not a loop-threaded tally. A NO-GO names the precise failure mechanism; neither outcome is massaged.

correlationId.description: Run id whose reopen + spend facts are folded from the blackboard.

subtasks.description: The full pre-registered item set; its length is the total item count.

pendingRemaining.description: Items never dispatched (non-empty only when a budget halt stopped the run early).

finalHead.description: The shared branch head after the last wave.

testCycleState.description: Terminal state of the shared-branch test_cycle.

testsPassed.description: Whether the shared branch is green.

converged.description: True only when the pre-registered GO bar is met in full.

bigBangMerge.description: Whether a big-bang merge was used (must be false for GO).

undispatchedCount.description: Items never dispatched (budget halt); non-zero disqualifies GO.

spendUsd.description: Total accumulated run spend folded from the blackboard.

report.description: Human-readable GO/NO-GO summary naming the mechanism on a NO-GO.
